### 👨‍💻 About Me · Обо мне

🇬🇧 Full-stack developer focused on **TypeScript / Next.js** and shipping **AI-native products**.
I turn messy workflows into fast, reliable apps — from realtime dashboards to Telegram bots and MCP servers.

🇷🇺 Full-stack разработчик на **TypeScript / Next.js**, делаю **продукты с AI внутри**.

- 🚀 Building **[Merxion Planner](https://github.com/nikita-ursulenko)** — an AI-native task & project manager
